messages:
kai: Quick note from last night's soak: intermittent netlink WARNs + nvlink recovery loops observed in eu-central-1. Planning a staggered maintenance window: Thu 01:00-04:00 UTC. Aim: soft-drain -> BMC & NIC soft-reboot -> kernel livepatch if needed. Expect ~8-12% temporary capacity loss.

rachel: Ack. Any correlation with specific machine SKU or kernel version?

kai: Mostly on machines with vendor SKU X2 and kernel 5.15. Driver stack shows occasional Rx timeouts. We suspect a microcode + driver timing interaction.

omar: Can we narrow blast radius? I suggest 6 cohorts by rack group, canary = single rack (~3% capacity) for 15m.

kai: Agreed. Canary window 01:00-01:15. If stable, proceed cohorts 01:25-02:40, final sweep 02:50-04:00. Canary success = no P95 > 1.8% increase, no nvlink resets >1, no evictions >2.

jen: Ops runbook (short) + commands please. Support needs exact steps.

kai: Short runbook:
1) tag nodes: `kubectl annotate node NODE maintenance=softdrain`
2) drain gracefully: `kubectl drain NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=180 --timeout=8m`
3) run nic diagnostics: `nicdiag --node NODE --json`
4) soft BMC reboot: `ssh root@BMC_HOST "bmctool reboot --soft"`
5) check kernel dmesg for netlink warnings; apply livepatch only if warnings persist
6) uncordon + prefix warm: `kubectl uncordon NODE && prefixwarm --pool eu-central-1 --node NODE --wait 600`

omar: Add pre-warm step 10m before removing drain to reseed kvcache on neighbors.

kai: Will do. Also we'll flip routing bias to prefer cross-region failover for new requests (eu-west fallback) during 00:50-04:30 UTC to reduce stateful moves.

rachel: Cost estimate for temporary backfill? Finance wants a short number.

kai: Ballpark: 10% capacity backfill on-demand ~ $2.8k/hr for eu-central-1. If worst-case full 3h impact -> ~$8.4k. Tag instances with cost center 'infra-maint'.

jen: Tenant handling: any pinned customers?

kai: Three pinned tenants in the pool. Plan: pre-migrate one low-volume tenant to eu-west 12h before; others covered by reserved capacity. We'll notify tenant owners 48h and 2h prior.

omar: Monitoring/abort criteria?

kai: Abort if any of:
- P95 latency delta > 2% sustained 5m
- Evictions > 5 across the pool during cohort
- nvlink resets per node > 3
- prefix cache hit-rate drops > 6% sustained 10m

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created. PD reminder set 45m before. Auto-pager on P95 delta > 2.5% for 5m.

rachel: Who's oncall and canary lead?

kai: Oncall: rachel. Canary lead: omar. Ops: kai + jen. Channel: #eng-infra-maint pinned.

jen: I'll prepare the status page blurb and tenant email drafts. kai: please attach final runbook to PagerDuty ticket.

kai: Will update runbook and post final schedule in this thread after security signs off on BMC access. Thanks all :thumbsup:
